caption: The drawing depicts a large, ornate horn or trumpet, possibly of a ceremonial or heraldic nature, shown in profile against a plain background. The instrument is predominantly rendered in shades of gray, with intricate floral and decorative engravings along its flared bell and length. Attached to the horn is a thick, twisted rope or cord, which is colored in alternating bands of blue and a lighter, possibly beige hue. Two large blue tassels with detailed tops hang from the rope where it forms a loop above the horn. The overall composition centers on the horn, which is shown horizontally, and the rope drapes above it with the tassels hanging downward. The background is plain and beige, providing contrast to the detailed and colored elements of the horn and rope. The name “Samuel O. Klein” appears lightly inscribed in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Speaking Trumpet
